News Verification : The media had reports that The Phoenix Mills Limited may sell up to 30% of its stake in Phoenix  Hospitality to private equity investors for about $250 million. The Exchange, in order to verify the accuracy or otherwise of the information reported in the media and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the officials of the company.
